fieldDescriptions.IdentityProvider: Authentication service that produced the event.
fieldDescriptions.EventType: Authentication operation represented by the event.
fieldDescriptions.EventResult: Authentication outcome, such as Success or Failure.
fieldDescriptions.FailureReason: Reason an authentication attempt failed when present.
fieldDescriptions.TargetUsername: Account targeted by the authentication attempt.
fieldDescriptions.TargetUserId: Stable identifier for the targeted account.
fieldDescriptions.ActorUsername: Identity associated with the authentication attempt.
fieldDescriptions.SrcIpAddr: Source IP address for the authentication attempt.
fieldDescriptions.SrcCountry: Country associated with the source IP address.
fieldDescriptions.DeviceName: Device name reported for the sign-in when available.
fieldDescriptions.AuthenticationProtocol: Authentication protocol used by the client.
fieldDescriptions.MfaResult: Outcome of multifactor authentication when required.
fieldDescriptions.RiskLevel: Provider-assigned risk level for the sign-in.
fieldDescriptions.RiskReasons: Provider-assigned risk signals associated with the sign-in.
fieldDescriptions.NetworkLocation: Network location classification for the sign-in.

context.productDescription: Synthetic authentication telemetry from the fictional Fabrikam Identity Hub service provider for testing the Sentinel Content Forge Accelerator.
knownSecurityScenarios: Multiple failed password attempts against different accounts from one external source.
Successful authentication following a sequence of failed password attempts from the same external source.
Repeated denied multifactor authentication attempts followed by a successful sign-in.
A successful sign-in from an unfamiliar device and country shortly after a normal sign-in.
Legacy authentication activity without multifactor authentication.
